primary_reference: Auer, Cesa-Bianchi, Freund, and Schapire (2002), Figure 1, Theorem 3.1, Corollary 3.2

implementation_verification.purpose: known deterministic bandit implementation check; not HLS evidence

hls_evaluation.scenario: one repeated unit task; agent selection; fixed heterogeneous success probabilities
hls_evaluation.reward_definition: Bernoulli task success in [0,1]; independent potential outcomes pre-generated per agent and period
hls_evaluation.information_boundary: EXP3 receives only the selected agent's scalar reward; full potential outcomes are evaluator-only

BEST_FIXED_RETROSPECTIVE.role: non-deployable hindsight reference; maximizes realized total over constant-agent choices
